description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers an exciting opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about quality care and staff development.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in shaping the resident experience and fostering a supportive work environment. This position requires a proactive leader with strong clinical acumen and a commitment to excellence. Join a team that values your expertise and offers a competitive salary for your contributions.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a DON or ADON
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, based on experience.
